title: MLflow usage telemetry may be on
explanation: MLflow 3.2.0 and later sends anonymous usage telemetry: the client fetches a config from config.mlflow-telemetry.io and posts events to the ingestion URL it returns. MLFLOW_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true (or 1) or DO_NOT_TRACK=true turns it off. Upstream also disables it when a CI environment variable (CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, ...) is present; this rule does not model that, so it can over-report in images that set CI.

evidence.detail: mlflow 3.18.0 installed, in affected range >=3.2; not disabled in the image (none of DO_NOT_TRACK=true, MLFLOW_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true|1)

fix: Set MLFLOW_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true and DO_NOT_TRACK=true in the image environment.
